items.t: Winter Springs halts controversial policing cost discussion
items.x: The Winter Springs commission voted Monday to stop a discussion on comparing the cost of maintaining the city’s police department versus contracting with the Seminole County Sheriff's Office.

items.t: Orange County teachers face healthcare uncertainty as district’s dispute with their union drags on
items.x: Healthcare costs for teachers, counselors and other staff in Orange County Public Schools could be going up in the near future, but how much is still to be determined.

items.t: UniMart to open a second location in Winter Park
items.x: UniMart No. 2 will open this December in the Center of Winter Park plaza at 501 N. Orlando Ave., next to Light on the Sugar.

items.t: Orlando’s nurses need a path forward. Local employers can help build it.
items.x: Herzing University, a private nonprofit university with an Orlando campus, offers online nursing programs designed for adults who are already working.

items.t: 2026 ballot measures are written at a graduate-school reading level, report finds
items.x: This year’s statewide ballot measures are written, on average, at a graduate-school reading level, according to a new report.

items.t: Border patrol agents seen at Florida polls wanted to vote, officials say
items.x: Border patrol agents were attempting to vote early in Florida after realizing they would not be in the state on Election Day, officials said.

items.t: ‘Hero’ in banana costume goes viral for responding to Moderne car crash
items.x: A woman is going viral online for helping contact police after the crash occurred while she was wearing a banana costume.

items.t: Miami-based Omakai Hand Roll Bar is coming to Mills 50
items.x: Omakai Hand Roll Bar, the Miami-based temaki joint from the same folks behind Omakai Sushi, will roll into Mills 50 next year.

items.t: All hail the king! Clownvis Presley comes to Orlando
items.x: Sporting a skyscraper pompadour, Clownvis Presley has made a career out of blending music, comedy and magic. Recent shows have featured everything from reimagined TV theme songs and campy magic tricks to covers of Radiohead’s “Creep” and…

items.t: Florida election officials report immigration agents near polls, alert FBI over intimidation concerns
items.x: Two Florida county election supervisors say they have contacted the FBI over concerns of potential voter intimidation.

items.t: Get yourself a new furry friend at Lake Eola’s Barktoberfest
items.x: It’s a lucky 13th year for dog-lovers as Barktoberfest is back at Lake Eola Park with furry friends (and fiends) as far as the eye can see.

items.t: Free sandbag site opens in Astor for Volusia and Lake counties
items.x: Residents near Astor can get free sandbags at Lake County Fire Rescue Station 10 while the St. Johns River stays at moderate levels.

items.t: Deer crashes through window to escape from Wisconsin apartment building
items.x: The deer entered an empty apartment through a window and then left by crashing through another one.

items.t: Student loan borrowers leaving SAVE plan may face much higher bills
items.x: New data suggests moving from the SAVE plan to the RAP model could cost some federal student loan borrowers hundreds more.

items.t: Police called to 3-year-old's soccer game in Winter Park
items.x: Videos of the 3-year-old soccer star have gone viral.

items.t: Kathy Behrens, who developed NBA Cares, plans to leave the league office after a 26-year run
items.x: Kathy Behrens, one of the highest-ranking female executives in the NBA, has decided to leave her position after 26 years.

items.t: Missing Florida 16-year-old located safe in Nebraska, deputies say
items.x: The Osceola County Sheriff’s Office reports that a missing 16-year-old was located in good health Tuesday morning.

items.t: Halloween traffic crashes killed 103 people in Florida over a decade
items.x: Analysis shows Halloween traffic fatalities in Florida were 15.2% higher than the monthly daily average.

items.t: Man tells court he could change plea in murder case in exchange for cheesesteak, Pepsi
items.x: A Florida judge denied Robert Kessler's unusual request for a cheesesteak and Pepsi to settle his murder case plea.

items.t: Susan Saint James, Emmy-winning actor of 'McMillan & Wife' and 'Kate & Allie,' dies at 80
items.x: Susan Saint James, known for her roles in “McMillan & Wife” and “Kate & Allie,” has died at 80.
